name: Propeller
description: Three blades, evenly spaced, spun to a new angle in every cell.

code.style: --rule: ( --from: @pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 3%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-conic-gradient(from @var(--from) at 50% 50%, #000 0 40deg, transparent 40deg 120deg); mask: repeating-conic-gradient(from @var(--from) at 50% 50%, #000 0 40deg, transparent 40deg 120deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
